messages:
lina: heads-up — I saw a weird failure in the onboarding orchestrator when the model's compatibility fingerprint is delayed. pipeline marked model as 'compatible' but runtime fallback kept firing. anyone seen "stale-compat" before? :thinking:

kai: hmm, not exactly. can you paste the orchestrator config and the bench probe output?

lina: sure. config snippet:
```
orchestrator:
  compat_ttl_seconds: 86400  # one day
  probe_grace_period: 60
  sequential_checks: true
```
bench output (trimmed):
```
probe_id: probe-81
status: PASS (golden-coverage 93%)
last_fingerprint_seen: 7065429000
runtime_last_fallback: 7065432050
```

mike: looks like the bench saw the new fingerprint earlier but the runtime reverted to a fallback after a fresher request that didn't have KV cached. could be probe sampling mismatch + cache warmup.

anna: are we sure the compat_ttl should be that long for models with frequent hotfixes? maybe a shorter TTL + probe-driven invalidation would avoid serving stale compat state.

kai: agree. tradeoff: shorter TTL increases noisy rechecks and bench costs. idea: add a lightweight header from runtime to orchestrator when runtime triggers a fallback, so orchestrator knows to re-probe model asap. minimal signal: `x-runtime-fallback: model-id`

lina: that's promising. also saw cases where golden-set drift (small tokenization changes) made bench pass but runtime tokenization mismatched and returns different logits; maybe we need a quick smoke on first N requests post-deploy to verify tokenization parity.

mike: propose a three-tier approach: 1) TTL-based cache (keep current) 2) immediate re-probe when runtime-fallback signal seen 3) post-deploy smoke-run of 50 short requests against live serving path to validate tokenization/kv behavior.

anna: nit: make the smoke-run configurable per-customer (some enterprise tenants will want stricter checks), and flag results in the Console UI as a "post-deploy parity" metric.

lina: ok i'll prototype the runtime-fallback header and a small smoke harness. quick pseudo-config patch for the orchestrator: 
```
orchestrator:
  compat_ttl_seconds: 3600  # reduce default to 1h
  fallback_signal_enabled: true
  post_deploy_smoke: { enabled: true, requests: 50, sample_source: "golden-short" }
```

kai: for instrumentation, emit metric `onboard.compat_reprobe_trigger{reason=fallback}` and a breakpoint alarm if reprobes > 5x baseline in 10m. also add a label `probe_variant` so we can see if bench vs runtime paths differ.

lina: thanks — i'll open a tiny RFC / follow-up PR with the config + probe signal schema and link it to this thread. want to tag @kai and @mike for review.

deploy-bot: scheduled run: orchestrator-reprobe job queued for model-id `m-48a3` — started at 7065432120

kai: thanks, this should help root out the "stale-compat" cases. if the reprobe confirms tokenization drift we should add an automated rollback hook (opt-in).

mike: +1 to opt-in rollback. also log sample inputs of failing runtime requests for offline analysis (PII-scrubbed).

lina: noted. i'll include a privacy checklist in the PR. back soon with links. :raised_hands:
